name: restromanager
description: Restaurant & Food Service Management System — a full-stack web app for running a restaurant's floor: browse and manage the menu, track table availability, take orders, follow them through preparation, and check daily sales. The front end is React with Tailwind CSS, the back end is a plain Express REST API, and all data lives in MySQL accessed through raw parameterised SQL (no ORM). Everything runs locally on a single machine — no Docker, no cloud services, no external APIs.

scripts.hacka47: concurrently "cd server && npm run dev" "cd client && npm run dev"
